subject.title: bug: 主 Telegram session 被 lifecycleGeneration 静默重置，上下文丢失

question: Should maintainers close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95498 as superseded now that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95472 is shipped, or preserve its unique positive-path test first?
rationale: The issue’s central bug is fixed, but an open member-authored linked PR still carries closing syntax and may contain one extra regression test; that cleanup choice should be made by a maintainer.

options.title: Close Superseded PR Then Close Issue
options.body: Treat the shipped https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95472 fix as canonical, close the conflicting linked PR, and then close this issue as fixed.

options.title: Preserve Extra Test First
options.body: Cherry-pick or reimplement only the unique current-generation running-session positive-path test from the linked PR before closing both items.

options.title: Keep Open For Broader Session Policy
options.body: Leave the issue open only if maintainers believe the original report still tracks a separate daily-reset or restart-metadata policy problem beyond the shipped guard.

recommendation.title: Close Superseded PR Then Close Issue
recommendation.body: Treat the shipped https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95472 fix as canonical, close the conflicting linked PR, and then close this issue as fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: openperf owns the still-open linked PR whose disposition blocks clean issue closure.
